responsibility: Provides the AVX-512BW + AVX-512VL intrinsic interface for byte and word operations on 128-bit and 256-bit vectors. This header adds VL-sized masked move/load/store helpers, blends, comparisons, and other byte/halfword operations, using unaligned helper vector typedefs and GCC builtins to expose the narrower AVX-512BW API that complements the 512-bit-only definitions in avx512bwintrin.h.
